title: model-routing.v1 — the operator-tunable execution-posture lines
description: The self-instruction lines the engine loads for each execution posture: `qualified` for a `matched` environment, `conservative-default` for every other. They used to be two fenced text blocks inside .engine/policies/model-routing.md, parsed back out at boot; a policy page is judgment prose, not a data store, so the lines live here and the page carries a generated projection (StarshipSuperjam/engine-template#821). The loader falls back to the engine's built-in conservative default on any miss and never raises into boot; this schema is what the model-routing merge check enforces.

lines.description: One posture's self-instruction lines, relayed verbatim in the boot briefing's never-shed execution block; bounded so the block the briefing floors at eight lines can never be gutted or flooded from here.
